Leblanc, I., Janusauskas, D. and St-Onge, J.-F. (2014). Potential economic and operational benefits and impacts of trolley assist in open pit mining. BBA Inc., Canada, May 2014. 22 pp.

Short BBA paper (22 pages) on trolley assist for large Canadian open pits. Loaded: per truck-hour operating cost with and without trolley assist (Table 1), trolley system capital and operating costs (Tables 2 and 3, images in the PDF read from rendered pages), diesel CO2 factor and emission reduction range. No energy intensity per tonne or per tonne-km is printed, and no truck price. Locator: printed page = PDF page ("Page N" footer). Traps: the dollar currency and price year are not stated (CAD and 2014 assumed); Table 3 (operating costs) is titled "capital costs" in the paper; fuel and electricity costs per hour carry no price, so litres and kWh per hour cannot be derived; the 22 $/h saving = fuel 26 + engine repair 6 - electricity 10 (repairs and PM 136 vs 130 includes the 6).
